policy: Apply reviewed exact-item disenchant cohorts to their default expansion + input rarity + armor/weapon category. Preserve item identity as provenance. Use an item-specific override only when positive evidence establishes an item-specific exception. Missing historical level/skill/spec alone does not withhold the category estimate.

classIDs.4: armor (including rings, trinkets, shields and held-in-off-hand items)

classificationScope: Current/default catalog categories; these fields do not claim each historic Looter operation used the selected current catalog item variant. Inferred qualities remain provisional and may be corrected by stronger item-version metadata.
poolingNotes: Do not count multiple material rows from the same study as separate input casts.
Same-item Looter snapshots may overlap; select a single nonoverlapping snapshot per item rather than summing cumulative snapshots.

The Miki 1000 Courtly Wrists max-specialization study and the older 2261-operation Courtly Wrists Looter study have different context and unresolved cohort overlap; retain context and do not blindly sum them.
No item-specific yield exception has been demonstrated for these 23 inputs.
The generic rare-gear Aspalar study has no exact inputItemID and is intentionally not an item classification mapping.
